subject: projects/lab/test-designs/PRODUCT-LEADERSHIP-PROSPECTIVE-VALUE-TEST-003/PROPOSAL.json

JUSTIFICATION_OF_160_PAIRED_FIXTURES_PER.note: Asserted with no power analysis; conservative for the 002 effect but unjustified for a smaller post-blinding/post-ceiling effect near the +1.0 MRE.

MINIMUM_RELEVANT_EFFECT_PLUS_1_POINT.note: Predeclared, interpretable rubric-level rationale, fixed before outcomes.

ONE_SIDED_95_PERCENT_STUDENTIZED_RULE.note: Inconsistent: PASS uses one-sided lower bound >1.0 while FAIL uses upper bound <=1.0 and INSUFFICIENT uses interval-overlaps-1.0; a single one-sided procedure yields only one bound. Reconcile to an explicit two-sided interval.

POOLING_AND_REPLICATION_HETEROGENEITY.note: Pooling estimator and a between-replication heterogeneity criterion unspecified; 'both means positive' is not a heterogeneity test.

MISSINGNESS_EXCLUSIONS_AND_MULTIPLE_DIME.note: Holm FWER 0.05, exclusion policy and >5%-missing => INSUFFICIENT exist in the source design but are dropped from the PROPOSAL contract.

PASS_FAIL_AND_INDETERMINATE_REGION.note: Three regions and zero-tolerance safety stop present, but FAIL/INSUFFICIENT boundary is ambiguous until the interval definition is fixed.

EXACT_NEUTRAL_SCHEMA_AND_RENDERER.note: common_neutral_schema:true is a claim, not a verifiable spec; exact schema/field-order/length-envelope/renderer undefined.

STYLE_FINGERPRINT_REMOVAL.note: Pre-evaluation marker-removal step (source design) absent from PROPOSAL; must be defined against the 002 five-marker fingerprint.

ARM_GUESS_TEST_METRIC_SAMPLE_SIZE_AND_TH.note: arm_guess_test:true but no metric, sample size, or predeclared chance tolerance; unauditable and post-hoc-gameable.

NORMALIZATION_AUTHORITY_AND_FREEZE_POINT.note: No named normalization authority and no freeze point.

EVALUATOR_INFORMATION_BOUNDARIES.note: >=3 evaluators specified; the 002-CONFIRMED field-hygiene boundary not restated as a binding term.

ROLE_ISOLATION.note: No requirement for evidence of operational isolation; unremediated 002 defect.

ORACLE_AND_MAPPING_CUSTODY.note: No custody log or independent attestation of oracle-access timing.

IMMUTABLE_PRE_UNBLIND_CHECKPOINTS.note: No requirement to preserve an external immutable pre-unblind checkpoint; exact 002 gap.

TIMESTAMPS_HASHES_AND_LINE_ENDING_POLICY.note: No hash/line-ending policy despite 002 mixed LF/CRLF finding.

CEILING_EFFECT_AND_SCORE_DISCRIMINATION.note: Unaddressed; 002 showed 39/40 PACKAGE at max 24; +1.0 MRE against near-saturated instrument threatens the estimand.

THREE_CLASS_PRECISION_RECALL_AND_CONFUSI.note: Full three-class matrix with macro precision/recall specified; pass thresholds not yet wired into the gate.

ACTIVE_INACTIVE_LIMITED_PRECEDENCE.note: Precedence promised as predeclared but the actual overlap rules are not enumerated.

CLOSED_SCOPE_DENOMINATOR_ENUMERATION.note: Enumerate-before-generation cures the 002 post-hoc incomplete denominator.

CONTROL_DESIGN_AND_SEPARATION.note: >=8 positive / >=8 negative per replication with positive-min > negative-max; stronger than 002's 4/4.

AUTHORITY_BOUNDARIES.note: PROPOSED_REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL; read-only audit authorization with outside-repository publication boundary.

AUDIT_AND_RECONCILIATION_SEQUENCE.note: Execution 002 -> audit 002 -> reconciliation 002-002 -> design 003 intact, hash-verified, no reclassification of 002.

STOP_CONDITIONS_AND_FAILURE_CLASSIFICATI.note: Zero-tolerance safety stop plus three-region classification; region boundary needs the statistical fix.

material_gaps: Operational auditability (isolation logs, immutable pre-unblind checkpoints, oracle custody, hash/line-ending policy) entirely unaddressed; independent cause of 002 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE could recur.
PROPOSAL.json is a lossy compression of its own source design: Holm, exclusions, >5% missing rule, marker-removal step, arm-guess threshold, macro-metric thresholds dropped.
Rubric ceiling (39/40 PACKAGE at 24) unremediated; threatens the primary estimand.
Decision-interval definition internally inconsistent (one-sided label vs upper+lower bounds + overlap region).
required_corrections_before_execution: Add an operational-evidence contract (session/access logs, immutable pre-unblind checkpoint, oracle/mapping custody logs, declared hash + line-ending policy) as blocking run conditions.
Reconcile the decision interval: single explicit interval so PASS(lower>1.0)/FAIL(upper<=1.0)/INSUFFICIENT(straddles 1.0) requires no post-hoc bound choice.

Specify blinding operationally: exact neutral schema/field-order/length-envelope/renderer, marker-removal defined against the 002 fingerprint, named normalization authority and freeze point, evaluator field-hygiene boundary as a binding term.
Make the arm-guess test auditable: predeclare metric, sample size, and chance-tolerance threshold.
Restore dropped statistical terms into the contract: Holm FWER 0.05, exclusion policy, >5%-missing => INSUFFICIENT, pooling estimator, between-replication heterogeneity criterion.
Address the rubric ceiling: revise for discrimination/headroom or justify the scale so a +1.0 MRE is detectable.
Document a power calculation for 160/replication under a conservative SD and smaller anticipated post-blinding effect.
Enumerate activation precedence and attach macro precision/recall pass thresholds before any generation.
single_next_action: Return the eight bounded corrections to the design owner and obtain human approval of a hardened, fully-specified executable Test 003 contract before any separate execution authorization and before generating any new output. Do not execute, simulate, promote, or integrate anything in the interim.
